concerns.text: Coverage table re-labels FR-001 as 'download & preprocess ≥1 real dataset' while spec FR-001 mandates 'at least three public scRNA-seq datasets'. This is a silent requirement weakening: no spec amendment (plan Phase 0.3 case-study update) has been recorded, yet the tasks document pre-concedes the weakening. Either restore '≥3' with the abort/case-study path as an explicitly spec-sanctioned fallback, or amend the spec first.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T004 (geometric diagnostics) vs spec.md:FR-002/FR-003 and constitution.md:Principle VI
concerns.text: T004 computes trustworthiness as trustworthiness(X_highdim, X_pca30) and 'local continuity' as the reverse-direction trustworthiness — i.e., the diagnostics are defined relative to a PCA-30 embedding. Spec FR-002/003 require the metrics 'on the high-dimensional space', and Constitution VI requires them 'directly from the high-dimensional raw gene expression space prior to any dimensionality reduction'. Anchoring the predictor to one of the evaluated methods (PCA) is a semantic weakening of both FRs and Principle VI; the task should compute embedding-free diagnostics or the spec/constitution must be explicitly amended with justification.

T007 fits fixed-effects ANOVA when ≤1 dataset resolves, but FR-006 mandates the mixed-effects model `fidelity ~ method + (1|dataset)` and the statistical_result schema hard-codes `random_effects_variance: null` ('Null for Fixed-Effects ANOVA'), so the MixedLM branch T007 describes for >1 dataset cannot emit schema-valid output. The case-study downgrade is documented in plan.md but the spec was never updated (plan Phase 0.3 requires a spec.md amendment); T012 only conditionally updates plan.md, not spec.md. The staging must be made explicit in the spec, not silently absorbed by the task.

T006's fidelity_results.csv columns (silhouette_score, optimal_resolution, runtime_seconds, peak_ram_gb; no silhouette_threshold) violate the active contract, which REQUIRES a `silhouette_threshold` column and sets `additionalProperties: false`. A task whose deliverable cannot validate against the contract it operates under is a constraint violation; either the task must conform or the contract must be revised.

T009 claims combined_metrics.parquet conforms to metrics_schema.schema.yaml semantics, but writes columns `trustworthiness`/`local_continuity` while the schema REQUIRES `global_linearity` (defined as Variance Explained Ratio) and `local_density` (Local PCA Reconstruction Error) with `additionalProperties: false`. The artifact cannot validate; the task silently redefines the contract's metric semantics.

Constitution VI states the geometric diagnostics 'serve as the predictor variables for the study', but T007's model formula is `fidelity ~ method` only — geometric JSONs are merged but never enter the model as predictors. No task anywhere uses the diagnostics as predictors, silently dropping a constitutional constraint.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T008 vs spec.md:FR-007/SC-001 and plan.md:Sensitivity Analysis
concerns.text: T008 implements both the Silhouette-threshold sweep {0.4,0.5,0.6} (spec FR-007/SC-001) and the Leiden-resolution sweep (plan), but plan.md maps SC-001 to the resolution sweep only. The tasks document should state which sweep SC-001's variance < 0.05 verdict is computed over (T008 computes variance 'across resolutions and thresholds as specified' — ambiguous), so the acceptance criterion is not silently re-scoped.
